ledger: Boy's left hand | reaches into bowl to assist holding a red ball at 00:00-00:01 | grasps the upper right rim of the glass bowl from 00:02 to 00:09 | maintains steady contact on the bowl rim after 00:02

Boy's right hand | reaches into bowl at 00:00, lifts red ball with left hand at 00:01, drops it at 00:02 | stirs balls rapidly inside the bowl from 00:05 to 00:09 | fingers clip through the balls and balls lose solid contact boundaries during rapid stirring at 00:06-00:09

Colored balls in glass bowl | solid spherical balls resting in bowl and moved by hand from 00:00 to 00:05 | deforming and interpenetrating blobs swirling around the bowl at 00:06-00:09 | lose solidity and clip through each other and the boy's fingers starting at 00:06

findings.entity: Boy's right hand and colored balls
findings.description: As the boy's right hand stirs the bowl rapidly from 00:06 to 00:09, the balls lose physical solidity, clipping through each other to form a flat dark-red mass beneath his palm while his fingers pass directly through the red and green balls at 00:08-00:09 instead of displacing them as solid objects.
Between 00:07 and 00:09, balls along the perimeter of the bowl slide and circulate around the hand without consistent directional pushing contact from the fingers.
